why: corr-3 showed XH3's MP2 lead over Xater is not shrinking: it went 2.44 with an f, 2.24 with a second f, back to 2.59 with a g instead, and the swings are all in the Hartree-Fock part (correlation's part holds at 2.5-2.75 kcal/mol).
